label: 1x16 PLC splitter, SC/APC, grade C bare splitter
description: 1x16 symmetrical PLC bare splitter, SC/APC on the 1 m input pigtail and on all sixteen 1 m output pigtails, 0.25 mm fibre, 1260-1650 nm. Grade C parts are the value end of the range: insertion loss <=14.3 dB, uniformity <=1.6 dB, PDL <=0.3 dB, return loss >=50 dB.
notes: CommScope product specification: 1 x 16 symmetrical PLC, SC/APC in and out, G.657.A2, insertion loss max 14.3 dB, uniformity max 1.6 dB, PDL max 0.3 dB, directivity min 55 dB, return loss min 50 dB, 1260-1650 nm, 4 x 5 x 45 mm, 1 m pigtails at 0.25 mm, -40 to +70 C. Worth knowing: 14.3 dB is 0.1 dB worse than the simulator's worst-case figure for a 1:16 (14.2 dB), so a grade C part used in a 20 km class B+ plan is marginally over what the budget engine assumes - the 50 dB return loss (against 55 on the Prysmian part) is the other sign that this is the cheaper grade.
